taxonomy:
# Taxonomy of Grid-Based Logic Puzzles

## 1. Number Placement Puzzles
*(Fill cells with numbers according to constraints)*
- Sudoku
- Fillomino
- Ripple Effect
- Makaro
- Nansuke
- Hebi

## 2. Region Division Puzzles
*(Divide the grid into defined areas or blocks)*
- Shikaku
- Five Cells
- Sashigane
- Double Choco
- Choco Banana
- Norinori
- Nuritwin
- Evolomino

## 3. Cell Shading Puzzles
*(Paint or colour cells black according to constraints)*
- Hitori
- Nurikabe
- Heyawake
- Kurodoko
- Kurotto
- Usowan
- LITS
- Sto-stone
- Chained Block
- Tilepaint
- Shakashaka
- Nurimisaki

## 4. Single Loop Puzzles
*(Draw a single continuous closed loop)*
- Slitherlink
- Masyu
- Yajilin
- Dotchi-Loop
- Moon-or-Sun
- Mid-loop
- Nagareru
- Suraromu

## 5. Path and Connection Puzzles
*(Connect elements or trace paths without loops)*
- Hashiwokakero
- Numberlink
- Nurimeizu
- Pencils

## 6. Object Placement Puzzles
*(Place specific objects into the grid)*
- Akari
- Juosan
- Sto-stone

## 7. Movement and Relocation Puzzles
*(Move or redirect elements within the grid)*
- Satogaeri
- Yosenabe

---

*Note: Sto-stone appears in Cell Shading (primary mechanic); categories reflect dominant solving mechanic.*
